cohort: Women from Georgian Court University faculty, staff, students, and alumni, as well as women undergoing HypnoBirthing, home birthing, and water birthing.
finding: Fear states during labor are associated with higher incidences of interventions and C-sections, while low fear is associated with self-reported calm states and more-positive birth experiences.
mod_finding: Higher fear states were associated with higher incidences of interventions and c-sections.
